source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 30 April 1930, p. 15 ("Apathy in Rural Districts"); withdrawals from the Lurgan Mail, 10 May 1930, p. 4 ("No Contests in Armagh: County Council Nominees Withdraw")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: every name and label checked against the page image; returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the county council, 1930: nominations received by T. E. Reid, secretary, 29 April 1930; after withdrawals there was no contest in the county. Returned unopposed. Printed "Killevy".
